body.statement: If the entries of \(P\), \(c\), and a queried \(\Delta\) are real algebraic, then membership in either \(\Theta_{\mathrm w}(P)\) or \(\Theta_{+}(P)\), projection onto \(c\) or \(\Delta\), the algebraic endpoint values, and their inclusion flags are decided by a terminating real-closed-field quantifier-elimination procedure applied to the principal-minor form of the finite lift.
body.justification: The finite representation yields an exact decision procedure even on singular and weakly infeasible faces.
body.gap: Existing implementations use slope grids and numerical convex solvers; no exact algebraic membership and endpoint-inclusion result is stated for the feedback model.
body.consumer: It provides a correctness benchmark for certified solvers and eliminates arbitrary support and slope grids for algebraically encoded inputs.
